title.en: The Companions of the Cave: Youths Who Stood Firm
title.hi: Ashab-e-Kahf: Woh Naujawan Jo Datt Gaye

status: draft: to be checked by a scholar before public release

say.en: A few young believers, a whole people against them, and a cave where Allah kept them asleep for years.
say.hi: Chand imaan wale naujawan, unke khilaf poori qaum, aur ek ghaar jahan Allah ne unhein saalon tak sulaye rakha.

say.en: Allah tells their story in truth: they were youths who believed in their Lord, and He increased them in guidance.
say.hi: Allah unka qissa sach ke saath sunata hai: woh naujawan apne Rabb par imaan laaye, aur Allah ne unki hidayat aur badha di.

say.en: Allah made their hearts firm when they stood up and said: our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We will never call on any god besides Him.
say.hi: Allah ne unke dil mazboot kar diye jab woh khade hue aur bole: hamara Rabb aasmanon aur zameen ka Rabb hai. Hum Uske siwa kisi ko kabhi nahi pukaarenge.

say.en: Their own people had taken other gods besides Allah, with no clear proof. And who does more wrong than one who invents a lie about Allah?
say.hi: Unki apni qaum ne Allah ke siwa doosre khuda bana liye the, bina kisi saaf daleel ke. Aur us se bada zaalim kaun jo Allah par jhoot ghade?

say.en: So they said to one another: now that you have left them and what they worship, take shelter in the cave. Your Lord will spread His mercy over you.
say.hi: To unhone aapas mein kaha: jab tum unse aur unke maboodon se alag ho gaye, to ghaar mein panaah le lo. Tumhara Rabb tum par apni rehmat phaila dega.

say.en: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmah, wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada. Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself, and prepare for us right guidance in our affair.
say.hi: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmah, wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada. Aye hamare Rabb, hamein apne paas se rehmat ata farma, aur hamare kaam mein hamare liye sahi raah bana de.

say.en: So Allah cast sleep over their ears in the cave, for a number of years.
say.hi: To Allah ne ghaar mein unke kaanon par neend ka parda daal diya, kai saalon ke liye.

say.en: When the sun rose, it turned away from their cave to the right, and when it set, it passed them on the left, while they lay in an open space inside. That was one of Allah's signs.
say.hi: Sooraj nikalta to unke ghaar se daayein taraf hat jaata, aur doobta to baayein taraf se guzar jaata, aur woh andar ek khuli jagah mein lete rehte. Yeh Allah ki nishaniyon mein se thi.

say.en: The youths who left their people for Allah lay asleep in the cave. You would have thought them awake, but they were asleep. Allah turned them to the right and to the left, and their dog lay stretching its forelegs at the entrance.
say.hi: Jo naujawan Allah ke liye apni qaum chhod aaye the, woh ghaar mein so rahe the. Aap unhein jaagta samajhte, halanke woh so rahe the. Allah unhein daayein aur baayein karwat dilata, aur unka kutta darwaze par apne agle paon phailaye baitha tha.

say.en: Then Allah woke them, and they asked one another how long they had stayed. They said: a day, or part of a day. Then they said: your Lord knows best.
say.hi: Phir Allah ne unhein jagaya, aur woh aapas mein poochhne lage ke kitni der thehre. Bole: ek din, ya din ka kuch hissa. Phir kaha: tumhara Rabb hi behtar jaanta hai.

say.en: They sent one of them to the city with their silver coin to bring food, and told him to be careful. If the people found them, they would stone them, or force them back to their religion.
say.hi: Unhone apne mein se ek ko chaandi ka sikka de kar shehar bheja ke khaana laaye, aur kaha ke hoshiyari se jaana. Agar logon ko pata chal gaya, to woh unhein sangsaar kar denge, ya zabardasti apne deen mein lauta lenge.

say.en: So Allah let the people find them, so that they would know that the promise of Allah is true, and that there is no doubt about the Hour.
say.hi: To Allah ne logon ko unki khabar de di, taake woh jaan lein ke Allah ka waada sach hai, aur qayamat mein koi shak nahi.

say.en: People will say three, or five, or seven, with their dog, guessing at the unseen. The Quran says: my Lord knows best their number, and only a few know them.
say.hi: Log kahenge teen, ya paanch, ya saat, aur unka kutta, bina dekhe andaaze lagate hue. Quran kehta hai: mera Rabb unki ginti behtar jaanta hai, aur unhein bahut kam log jaante hain.

say.en: The Quran says they stayed in their cave three hundred years, and added nine. And Allah knows best how long they stayed.
say.hi: Quran kehta hai ke woh apne ghaar mein teen sau saal rahe, aur nau saal aur. Aur Allah hi behtar jaanta hai ke woh kitna arsa rahe.

say.en: And the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: whoever learns by heart the first ten verses of Surah al-Kahf will be protected from the Dajjal.
say.hi: Aur Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya: jo Surah al-Kahf ki pehli das aayatein yaad kar le, woh Dajjal se mehfooz rahega.

heading.en: STAND FOR ALLAH. | *HE WILL SHELTER YOU.*
heading.hi: ALLAH KE LIYE DATTE RAHO. | *WOH PANAAH DEGA.*

say.en: If you ever stand alone for the truth, remember these youths. They left everything for Allah and asked Him for mercy, and He looked after them for years. Send this to someone who needs it today.
say.hi: Agar kabhi haq ke liye akele khade hon, to in naujawanon ko yaad karna. Unhone Allah ke liye sab chhoda aur Usse rehmat maangi, aur Usne saalon tak unki hifaazat ki. Yeh video usay bhejein jise aaj iski zaroorat hai.
